objects.definition:
#ifdef NEO_KHZ400
typedef uint16_t neoPixelType; ///< 3rd arg to Adafruit_NeoPixel constructor
#else
typedef uint8_t neoPixelType; ///< 3rd arg to Adafruit_NeoPixel constructor
#endif
objects.description: Typedef that encodes the LED color-order and speed flags passed to the Adafruit_NeoPixel constructor. It is uint16_t when 400 KHz support is enabled (to carry speed plus order bits), otherwise uint8_t. Use pointer type neoPixelType * when needed; actual underlying size is conditional on NEO_KHZ400.

C++ class that manages a strip or matrix of NeoPixel-compatible LEDs. Provides buffer management, color packing, pixel setting, brightness, timing, and hardware-specific output routines. Owns the pixel buffer and encapsulates hardware pin configuration. Construction via its constructors; destruction via ~Adafruit_NeoPixel().

functions.name: Adafruit_NeoPixel::Adafruit_NeoPixel
functions.signature: Adafruit_NeoPixel::Adafruit_NeoPixel(uint16_t n, int16_t pin = 6, neoPixelType type = NEO_GRB + NEO_KHZ800)
functions.description: Constructs a NeoPixel strip object specifying the number of LEDs, the output pin, and the pixel color order/bitrate (via NEO_* constants). Use this when you know the strip length and wiring at construction time.
requirements: n is the number of LEDs; must be >= 0 (0 allowed to create an empty strip)
pin is an Arduino pin number valid for the target platform
type must be a valid combination of NEO_* color order plus optional NEO_KHZ400/NEO_KHZ800 as defined in this header
Call begin() before attempting to transmit data with show()

functions.name: Adafruit_NeoPixel::Adafruit_NeoPixel
functions.description: Default constructor for a NeoPixel strip object with no length/pin/type preset. Use updateLength(), setPin(), and updateType() to configure before use.
requirements: After construction, configure the object (at minimum length and pin) before calling begin() and show()
Call begin() before attempting to transmit data with show()

functions.name: Adafruit_NeoPixel::~Adafruit_NeoPixel
functions.description: Destructor for the NeoPixel object. Frees any resources held by the instance (implementation-specific).
requirements: Do not use the object after destruction

functions.name: Adafruit_NeoPixel::begin
functions.description: Initializes internal state and prepares the output pin/hardware for driving the NeoPixel strip. Must be called before show(). Returns true on successful initialization.
requirements: Must be called successfully before show()
The pin and length should be configured (via constructor or setPin()/updateLength()) before begin() for expected behavior
Check the returned bool and avoid calling show() if initialization failed

functions.name: Adafruit_NeoPixel::show
functions.description: Transmits the pixel buffer to the LEDs. Observes the required latch/quiet interval after sending. Blocks until the required timing is satisfied.
requirements: begin() must have been called successfully prior to show()
Do not call show() faster than the required latch interval (~300 µs); use canShow() to check if it would block
Pixel data should be valid for the configured strip length and format

functions.name: Adafruit_NeoPixel::setPin
functions.description: Sets or changes the Arduino pin used to output NeoPixel data for this object.
requirements: p must be a valid, output-capable pin for the target platform
If changing the pin after begin(), behavior is implementation-defined; reinitialization via begin() may be required (not specified in header)

functions.name: Adafruit_NeoPixel::setPixelColor
functions.signature: void Adafruit_NeoPixel::setPixelColor(uint16_t n, uint8_t r, uint8_t g, uint8_t b)
functions.description: Sets the color of pixel n using separate 8-bit red, green, and blue values. Color bytes are written in the device-native order for the configured type.
requirements: n must be in range [0, numPixels()-1]
r, g, b are 0–255
The strip type (RGB vs RGBW) and byte order must be correctly configured via constructor or updateType()

functions.name: Adafruit_NeoPixel::setPixelColor
functions.signature: void Adafruit_NeoPixel::setPixelColor(uint16_t n, uint8_t r, uint8_t g, uint8_t b, uint8_t w)
functions.description: Sets the color of pixel n using separate 8-bit red, green, blue, and white values for RGBW strips.
requirements: n must be in range [0, numPixels()-1]
r, g, b, w are 0–255
The strip must be configured for a RGBW layout (via an appropriate NEO_* constant) for the white component to map to a distinct byte; behavior on RGB-only types is implementation-specific

functions.name: Adafruit_NeoPixel::setPixelColor
functions.description: Sets the color of pixel n using a packed 32-bit color value (RGB or WRGB depending on strip type).
requirements: n must be in range [0, numPixels()-1]
c must be a packed color produced consistently with the strip type (e.g., via Adafruit_NeoPixel::Color or ColorHSV)

functions.name: Adafruit_NeoPixel::fill
functions.signature: void Adafruit_NeoPixel::fill(uint32_t c = 0, uint16_t first = 0, uint16_t count = 0)
functions.description: Fills a range of pixels with the provided packed color value. If first and count are omitted, typical usage is to fill the entire strip. Behavior of count=0 is inferred from common library semantics.
requirements: c is a packed color appropriate for the strip type (RGB or WRGB)
first should be in range [0, numPixels()]
first+count should not exceed numPixels(); exact handling of out-of-range parameters is not specified in the header
Behavior for count=0 is not explicitly documented in the header; commonly this means fill to the end of the strip (inferred)

functions.name: Adafruit_NeoPixel::setBrightness
functions.description: Sets the global brightness scaling for the strip (0–255). Actual scaling method is implementation-specific.
requirements: Brightness argument must be in the range 0–255
Call before show() to affect subsequent transmissions

functions.name: Adafruit_NeoPixel::clear
functions.description: Clears the pixel buffer (sets all pixels to off/black). Does not transmit automatically; call show() to apply to the LEDs.
requirements: Call show() after clear() to update the physical LEDs

functions.name: Adafruit_NeoPixel::updateLength
functions.description: Changes the configured number of LEDs and resizes internal storage accordingly.
requirements: n must be >= 0
Existing pixel buffer pointers obtained from getPixels() may become invalid after this call; refresh any cached pointers
Avoid calling while a transmission (show()) is in progress

functions.name: Adafruit_NeoPixel::updateType
functions.description: Changes the configured pixel color byte order and, where supported, the signaling speed flag (400/800 KHz).
requirements: t must be a valid neoPixelType composed from NEO_* constants defined in this header
The selected order/speed must match the attached hardware to avoid incorrect colors or communication failure

functions.name: Adafruit_NeoPixel::canShow
functions.description: Checks whether a call to show() would start transmitting immediately or would block to satisfy the post-transmission latch interval (~300 µs). Useful to schedule low-priority work in the idle window.
requirements: None; can be called anytime
If it returns false, show() would block; callers may delay or perform other work

functions.name: Adafruit_NeoPixel::getPixels
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the raw pixel data buffer stored in device-native byte order. Intended for high-performance code to manipulate the buffer directly.
requirements: No bounds checking is performed when using this pointer; callers must not write past the allocated buffer
Format is device-native; callers must respect the configured byte order and presence/absence of white
Pointer may be null if length is zero or memory not yet allocated (e.g., before begin()/updateLength()); check before use

functions.name: Adafruit_NeoPixel::getBrightness
functions.description: Returns the currently configured global brightness level (0–255).
requirements: None

functions.name: Adafruit_NeoPixel::getPin
functions.description: Returns the Arduino pin number used for NeoPixel data output, or -1 if not set.
requirements: None

functions.name: Adafruit_NeoPixel::numPixels
functions.description: Returns the configured number of pixels in the strip object.
requirements: None

functions.name: Adafruit_NeoPixel::getPixelColor
functions.description: Retrieves the packed 32-bit color value of pixel n from the buffer (RGB or WRGB depending on configuration).
requirements: n must be in range [0, numPixels()-1]

functions.name: Adafruit_NeoPixel::sine8
functions.description: Looks up an 8-bit sine wave value from a PROGMEM table. Useful for animations and brightness curves.
requirements: x is 0–255; values wrap every 256 steps

functions.name: Adafruit_NeoPixel::gamma8
functions.description: Applies fixed gamma correction (exponent ~2.6) to an 8-bit value using a lookup table. Helps produce perceptually smoother brightness changes.

functions.name: Adafruit_NeoPixel::Color
functions.signature: static uint32_t Adafruit_NeoPixel::Color(uint8_t r, uint8_t g, uint8_t b)
functions.description: Packs separate 8-bit red, green, and blue values into a 32-bit RGB color value. Byte order of the packed value is library-defined and consistent with other helpers.
requirements: r, g, b are 0–255

functions.name: Adafruit_NeoPixel::Color
functions.signature: static uint32_t Adafruit_NeoPixel::Color(uint8_t r, uint8_t g, uint8_t b, uint8_t w)
functions.description: Packs separate 8-bit red, green, blue, and white values into a 32-bit WRGB color value.
requirements: r, g, b, w are 0–255

functions.name: Adafruit_NeoPixel::ColorHSV
functions.signature: static uint32_t Adafruit_NeoPixel::ColorHSV(uint16_t hue, uint8_t sat = 255, uint8_t val = 255)
functions.description: Converts HSV components to a packed 32-bit RGB/WRGB color suitable for setPixelColor(). Exact hue scaling and RGBW handling are implementation-specific in the source (.cpp).
requirements: sat and val are 0–255
Accepted hue range/scale is not specified in this header (commonly 0–65535 in Adafruit libraries); callers should consult implementation or test for expected mapping

functions.name: Adafruit_NeoPixel::gamma32
functions.description: Applies fixed gamma correction (exponent ~2.6) to a packed 32-bit RGB or WRGB color value.
requirements: x must be a packed color in the format expected by this library (RGB or WRGB depending on strip type)

functions.name: Adafruit_NeoPixel::rainbow
functions.signature: void Adafruit_NeoPixel::rainbow(uint16_t first_hue = 0, int8_t reps = 1, uint8_t saturation = 255, uint8_t brightness = 255, bool gammify = true)
functions.description: Generates a rainbow gradient across the strip and writes it into the pixel buffer, starting at first_hue, repeating reps times, with specified saturation/brightness and optional gamma correction.
requirements: The strip must have a nonzero length configured
Parameter ranges are not explicitly documented in the header; typical ranges are: first_hue in implementation-defined scale, reps small integer, saturation/brightness 0–255, gammify boolean

functions.name: Adafruit_NeoPixel::str2order
functions.description: Parses a string describing color byte order into a neoPixelType value (e.g., mapping textual orders to NEO_* constants).
requirements: v must be a valid, null-terminated C string pointer
Accepted strings and exact mapping are not specified in this header; consult implementation for supported formats

functions.name: espInit
functions.description: External initialization function required by the NeoPixel implementation on ESP32 platforms with ESP-IDF >= 5.0. Purpose is to initialize platform-specific resources (exact behavior defined in the corresponding source).
requirements: Only available/required when building for ESP32 with ESP-IDF version >= 5.0.0 (per conditional declaration)
No parameters and no return value; must be linked from platform support code
